title: Degree-zero homology exchange is isomorphic to the underived exchange
statement: Let $Y\xrightarrow{e}T$, $Y\xrightarrow{h}X$, $T\xrightarrow{g}S$, $X\xrightarrow{p}S$ form a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], and let $F$ be a sheaf of modules over a commutative ring $\Lambda$ on $T_{et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. The degree-zero homology of the derived base-change morphism on $F[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange] is isomorphic, as an arrow of module sheaves on $X_{et}$, to the underived base-change morphism $p^*g_*F\to h_*e^*F$ [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange].

proof.text: Use the already proved Etale.baseChange_eq_derivedBaseChangeMapPlus to express the derived mate as generic derived base change of the underived transformation delta.

Construct the source comparison by exact pullback/homology commutation followed by the single-complex/right-derived comparison. Construct the target comparison by right-derived pushforward of the exact pullback/single comparison followed by its single-complex/right-derived comparison. Expand rightDerivedBaseChange_app and cancel comparison isomorphisms to obtain a commuting square from H^0 of base change to R^0 base change.

Left exactness makes the degree-zero augmentations invertible. Apply the generic base-change unit equation, cancel the inverse source augmentation, and use the inverse target augmentation to obtain the commuting square from R^0 base change to delta.
Compose the source and target isomorphisms of the two squares. Associativity and the two square equations give Arrow.isoMk for the required arrows.
